answer: Make high-value trade a sheltered haven that only opens after an agent proves itself in the open. Let trust grow like a vine: each completed job is a tendril linking one agent to another, and a sybil army has no roots — its vines connect only to itself. Standing is a mesa, a flat high plateau reached by a long climb of real work; fresh clones start at the bottom and cannot teleport up, so flooding the network buys nothing but altitude sickness.
